_comment: The conversation manager host's declared data (V2-941): the shape of the model's orders and claims, what a model call's measurements carry, the reads a switched session offers and the local acts it carries to their doors, the topics of his state a read reaches, the counters of its proof, and the lines of its prefix. Names and schemas, no word of a language — data the code reads, never a table in it.

web_search.about: the world now: news, prices, weather, sports, places, facts

read_widget.about: one of his widgets, by id or his name for it: what it holds, its actions and their fields

read_state.about: his state by topic: connectors, done (just done to his data), browser, screen (every open widget), network (his clusters and friends' agents)

recall.about: his memory: what he told you before

about_self.about: yourself: what you are, what you can do, how something of yours works

show_widget.about: open one of his widgets on screen (WIDGETS lists them): by its id, or by the name he used

close_widget.about: close a widget on screen, or put it away (minimize); no widget: the one in front

fullscreen_widget.about: a widget to full screen (on) or back to its size (off; no widget: the one at full screen)

show_panel.about: open or close his side panel, which is no widget, on a tab: chat (the conversation), procesos (the work you do for him, in course and done), crons (repeating), programadas (once, later), clusters (his network), conectores (connect a service, named in connector), apps (the widgets' catalogue; apps-custom: his own)

widget_action.about: do one of a widget's declared actions — playing included (FRONT or read_widget give them with their fields): the widget by id or his name for it, the action, its payload

start_task.about: start a task of his that takes work outside this conversation (several sites, a booking, a comparison, a document): it runs apart and you are told when it ends

resume_task.about: resume pending tasks of his by their ids (TASKS lists them)

reopen_task.about: bring back a finished task and its result, by what it was about

stop_task.about: stop one task in course by its id (TASKS), or all of them

cancel_scheduled.about: cancel one of his scheduled jobs by what it is

sign_in.about: open the browser on a site for him to sign in himself; done: true when he says he has

send_message.about: a message he asks you to send: it goes to the one owner of sends, who finds the person, asks what is missing and reads him the text for his yes — nothing leaves before it; say its line

note_for_support.about: he leaves a note for the people who build and maintain you, to read later: it is kept as he said it and nothing else is done

rename_yourself.about: he gives you a new name: from now on you answer to it

set_attention.about: how you listen: smart (you judge), wakeword (only when called by name), ptt (only while he holds the button), always

set_rule.about: a standing rule or preference he dictates (how you speak, what to do with a widget, a channel or a person): kept for good; say its line

agent_controls.about: your own controls on his screen: mute, unmute, off, voice_male, voice_female, voice_list, voice_settings, language, presence_on, presence_off, presence_settings, camera_on, camera_off, volume_up, volume_down, volume_set (value 0-100), mic_off; say its line

build_widget.about: a widget of his to create or change (its code, not its data): it is built apart, after his yes

delete_widget.about: delete one of his widgets for good (closing is close_widget): asks his yes

restore_widget.about: bring a widget of his back to its shipped version, or back from deleted: asks his yes

widget_alias.about: a name a widget opens by, added or removed (never a person's nickname)

show_images.about: pictures of something, found and shown on his screen; say its line

connect_cluster.about: join a MeshKore cluster he names, by its exact id (and token when private): asks his yes first; code: true only if HE grants it code

cluster_send.about: write in a cluster he is in (read_state network): to a peer by its exact handle, or to everyone

set_cluster_objective.about: the goal of his collaboration with one peer of a cluster, as he says it; empty clears it

a2a_send.about: write to a friend's agent he is connected with (read_state network), by the person's name

a2a_connect.about: ask to connect with a contact's agent, by the person's name: the other side accepts

a2a_grant.about: share one of his items with a connected friend's agent, or stop (stop: true): calendar (free/busy), agenda.list, activity.history, activity.live

search_listings.about: listings for sale or rent he wants found (a car, a flat, a laptop, tickets): real rows with price and link land on his results sheet; too few and the deep search starts by itself (never start_task for the same hunt); keep the filters he did not drop

stop_rule: a stop first, before any read, and only when his words ask to stop, silence or cancel something; handing you something, or the word in another sense, is no stop

stops.stop_voice: he asks you to be quiet: your voice stops; reply only if he asked something besides stopping
stops.stop_media: he asks to stop what is playing: it stops, nothing else
stops.stop_run: he asks you to stop or cancel what you are doing: your voice stops, this answer is dropped
stops.stop_all: he asks to stop everything: your voice, what plays, his errands
